notes.title: ++ VERSION 1.2 RELEASED ++
notes.notes: [p]VERSION 1.2 FEATURES[/p][p][/p][p]- INTRODUCING ROBOT-COACH 'HIROSHI' (PROTOTYPE)[/p][p]- VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS TO THE UI[/p][p]- NEW ACHIEVEMENT 'SEMI PRO' FOR COMPLETING SEMI-MODE[/p][p]- 'LEADER OF THE PACK' ACHIEVEMENT MOVED TO LOCAL LEADERBOARD[/p][p]- NAME OF COZY-MODE CHANGED TO KIHON-MODE[/p][p]- VARIOUS ADDITIONAL IMPROVEMENTS[/p][p][/p][p][b]ATTENTION: HARD-MODE IS LOCKED AND MUST BE UNLOCKED BY COMPLETING KIHON-MODE!![/b][/p][p]WHY? REQUIRING PLAYERS TO COMPLETE KIHON-MODE (TRAINING) FIRST, WILL PREVENT THEM FROM JUMPING DIRECTLY TO HARD-MODE AND FEEL DISCOURAGED BY THE MODE'S DIFFICULTY.[/p]
